defs.c0: m del CENTRO del robot al punto del laser mas cercano en un cono de +-25 grados, tope 2.5 (= clear_dir del G1)
defs.c0_body: c0 - 0.361: lo que queda hasta el frente de la huella. El G1 no lo tiene; su cuerpo es ~0.2 m
defs.collision: NO es la del G1. wheel: mandado >=0.04 m en la ventana y las ruedas <25% de eso, con esfuerzo; effort: ruedas <50% de lo mandado y esfuerzo >1.7x la mediana libre; human: marcada a mano. Refractario 4 s, nunca durante una recuperacion de Nav2 (eso si es igual que el G1)
defs.drive_stall: ruedas paradas con mando y SIN esfuerzo: driver no habilitado, no un choque. No cuenta como colision
defs.collision_ahead: rechazo del comprobador de colision de Nav2. Es una PREDICCION, no un contacto: no cuenta como colision
defs.amcl_jump: discontinuidad de map->odom >= 0.04 m entre dos ticks. El G1 no lo tiene
defs.spd: velocidad lineal medida en las ruedas (joint_states x radio); si no hay, derivada de la pose
defs.loc_conf: fraccion de celdas del laser en vivo que caen sobre o junto a una celda ocupada del mapa (= match_score del G1)
defs.progression: g1_metrics.SEIMetrics con prog_ref=0.30 m/s, que es la marcha del G1. El Summit cruza a 0.05: compara progress_rate (m/s) si quieres unidades, progression si quieres la escala del G1

events.msg: Begin navigating from current location (-0.02, 0.02) to (1.83, -3.42)

params.behavior_server:
/robot/behavior_server:
  ros__parameters:
    /bond_disable_heartbeat_timeout: true
    backup:
      acceleration_limit: 0.0
      deceleration_limit: 0.0
      minimum_speed: 0.0
      plugin: nav2_behaviors/BackUp
    behavior_plugins:
    - spin
    - backup
    - drive_on_heading
    - wait
    costmap_topic: local_costmap/costmap_raw
    cycle_frequency: 10.0
    drive_on_heading:
      acceleration_limit: 0.0
      deceleration_limit: 0.0
      minimum_speed: 0.0
      plugin: nav2_behaviors/DriveOnHeading
    footprint_topic: local_costmap/published_footprint
    global_frame: robot_map
    max_rotational_vel: 1.0
    min_rotational_vel: 0.4
    robot_base_frame: robot_base_footprint
    rotational_acc_lim: 3.2
    simulate_ahead_time: 2.0
    spin:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors/Spin
    transform_tolerance: 0.5
    use_sim_time: false
    wait:
      plugin: nav2_behaviors/Wait
params.local_costmap/local_costmap:
/robot/local_costmap/local_costmap:
  ros__parameters:
    /bond_disable_heartbeat_timeout: true
    always_send_full_costmap: true
    filters: []
    footprint: '[[0.361,-0.3065],[0.361,0.3065],[-0.361,0.3065],[-0.361,-0.3065]]'
    footprint_padding: 0.02
    global_frame: robot_map
    height: 8
    lethal_cost_threshold: 100
    map_topic: /robot/map
    observation_sources: ''
    origin_x: 0.0
    origin_y: 0.0
    plugins:
    - top_laser_obstacle_layer
    publish_frequency: 5.0
    resolution: 0.02
    robot_base_frame: robot_base_footprint
    robot_radius: 0.1
    rolling_window: true
    top_laser_obstacle_layer:
      combination_method: 1
      enabled: true
      footprint_clearing_enabled: true
      front_right_scan:
        clearing: true
        data_type: LaserScan
        expected_update_rate: 10.0
        inf_is_valid: true
        marking: true
        max_obstacle_height: 1.0
        min_obstacle_height: 0.0
        observation_persistence: 1.0
        obstacle_max_range: 10.5
        obstacle_min_range: 0.0
        raytrace_max_range: 11.0
        raytrace_min_range: 0.0
        sensor_frame: ''
        topic: /robot/top_laser/scan
      max_obstacle_height: 2.0
      min_obstacle_height: 0.0
      observation_sources: front_right_scan
      plugin: nav2_costmap_2d::ObstacleLayer
    track_unknown_space: false
    transform_tolerance: 0.5
    trinary_costmap: true
    unknown_cost_value: 255
    update_frequency: 10.0
    use_maximum: false
    use_sim_time: false
    width: 8
params.controller_server:
/robot/controller_server:
  ros__parameters:
    /bond_disable_heartbeat_timeout: true
    FollowPath:
      BaseObstacle:
        class: BaseObstacle
        scale: 0.02
        sum_scores: false
      GoalAlign:
        aggregation_type: last
        class: GoalAlign
        forward_point_distance: 0.1
        scale: 24.0
      GoalDist:
        aggregation_type: last
        class: GoalDist
        scale: 24.0
      Oscillation:
        class: Oscillation
        oscillation_reset_angle: 0.2
        oscillation_reset_dist: 0.05
        oscillation_reset_time: -1.0
        scale: 1.0
        x_only_threshold: 0.05
      PathAlign:
        aggregation_type: last
        class: PathAlign
        forward_point_distance: 0.1
        scale: 32.0
      PathDist:
        aggregation_type: last
        class: PathDist
        scale: 32.0
      RotateToGoal:
        class: RotateToGoal
        lookahead_time: -1.0
        scale: 32.0
        slowing_factor: 5.0
      acc_lim_theta: 0.5
      acc_lim_x: 0.2
      acc_lim_y: 0.0
      angular_granularity: 0.025
      critics:
      - RotateToGoal
      - Oscillation
      - BaseObstacle
      - GoalAlign
      - PathAlign
      - PathDist
      - GoalDist
      debug_trajectory_details: true
      decel_lim_theta: -0.5
      decel_lim_x: -0.2
      decel_lim_y: 0.0
      default_critic_namespaces: []
      discretize_by_time: false
      forward_prune_distance: 2.0
      include_last_point: true
      limit_vel_cmd_in_traj: false
      linear_granularity: 0.05
      marker_lifetime: 0.1
      max_speed_xy: 0.25
      max_vel_theta: 0.6
      max_vel_x: 0.25
      max_vel_y: 0.0
      min_speed_theta: 0.0
      min_speed_xy: 0.0
      min_vel_x: -0.15
      min_vel_y: 0.0
      plugin: dwb_core::DWBLocalPlanner
      prune_distance: 2.0
      prune_plan: true
      publish_cost_grid_pc: false
      publish_evaluation: true
      publish_global_plan: true
      publish_local_plan: true
      publish_trajectories: true
      publish_transformed_plan: true
      short_circuit_trajectory_evaluation: true
      shorten_transformed_plan: true
      sim_time: 1.7
      time_granularity: 0.5
      trajectory_generator_name: dwb_plugins::StandardTrajectoryGenerator
      trans_stopped_velocity: 0.25
      transform_tolerance: 0.2
      vtheta_samples: 20
      vx_samples: 20
      vy_samples: 1
      xy_goal_tolerance: 0.25
    controller_frequency: 20.0
    controller_plugins:
    - FollowPath
    failure_tolerance: 0.3
    general_goal_checker:
      plugin: nav2_controller::SimpleGoalChecker
      stateful: true
      xy_goal_tolerance: 0.25
      yaw_goal_tolerance: 0.25
    goal_checker_plugins:
    - general_goal_checker
    min_theta_velocity_threshold: 0.001
    min_x_velocity_threshold: 0.001
    min_y_velocity_threshold: 0.5
    odom_topic: /robot/robotnik_base_control/odom
    progress_checker:
      movement_time_allowance: 10.0
      plugin: nav2_controller::SimpleProgressChecker
      required_movement_radius: 0.5
    progress_checker_plugin: progress_checker
    publish_zero_velocity: true
    speed_limit_topic: speed_limit
    use_sim_time: false
